tools.name: read_sample
tools.description: Read the first N rows of a file for schema inspection.

tools.name: detect_schema
tools.description: Infer column types, null counts, and unique value counts from a DataFrame.

tools.name: decide_read_more
tools.description: Determine whether the current sample is sufficient to understand the data schema.

tools.name: read_full_stats
tools.description: Compute aggregate statistics over the full file using chunked or lazy reading.

tools.name: compute_descriptive_stats
tools.description: Compute mean, std, min, max, and percentiles for all numeric columns.

tools.name: detect_nulls
tools.description: Compute null count and null percentage per column across the full file.

tools.name: detect_outliers
tools.description: Detect outliers in numeric columns using IQR and z-score methods.

tools.name: compute_correlation
tools.description: Compute Pearson or Spearman correlation matrix for numeric columns.

tools.name: detect_time_series
tools.description: Detect datetime columns and compute trends or seasonality patterns.

tools.name: detect_categorical_distributions
tools.description: Compute value counts and frequency distribution for categorical columns.

tools.name: auto_select_charts
tools.description: Use AI to select the most appropriate chart types for this dataset based on schema and EDA results.

tools.name: plot_histogram
tools.description: Plot distribution histogram of a numeric column.

tools.name: plot_bar
tools.description: Plot bar chart for categorical comparisons.

tools.name: plot_line
tools.description: Plot line chart for trends over time or ordered categories.

tools.name: plot_scatter
tools.description: Plot scatter chart to visualize correlation between two numeric columns.

tools.name: plot_heatmap
tools.description: Plot correlation heatmap from a correlation matrix.

tools.name: plot_boxplot
tools.description: Plot boxplot to visualize outliers and distribution spread.

tools.name: plot_pie
tools.description: Plot pie chart showing proportion of categories in a column.

tools.name: plot_missing_heatmap
tools.description: Plot heatmap showing null/missing value patterns across columns.

tools.name: plot_pairplot
tools.description: Plot pairwise scatter matrix for a set of numeric columns.

tools.name: plot_violin
tools.description: Plot violin chart showing distribution and density of a numeric column.

tools.name: write_summary
tools.description: Generate a prose narrative overview of the dataset based on schema and statistics.

tools.name: write_insights
tools.description: Generate key findings narrative covering trends, anomalies, and distributions.

tools.name: write_recommendations
tools.description: Generate optional actionable recommendations based on the insights.

tools.name: assemble_dashboard
tools.description: Assemble all sections into the final output file using the specified template and format.
